maddeler.e:
نستقرأ (form X)
# نُسْتَقْرَأُ (nustaqraʔu) /nus.taq.ra.ʔu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# نُسْتَقْرَأَ (nustaqraʔa) /nus.taq.ra.ʔa/: first-person plural non-past passive subjunctive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
# نُسْتَقْرَأْ (nustaqraʔ) /nus.taq.raʔ/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِسْتَقْرَأَ (istaqraʔa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
